label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Torá una será al natural y al peregrino el peregrinante en medio de ustedes.
spanish: Una ley será al natural y al peregrino el peregrinante en medio de ustedes.
grammarChanges: Translated תּוֹרָה (H8451, common noun 'law/instruction') as 'ley' instead of leaving the lemma untranslated and capitalized as the proper name 'Torá', per the cited auditor fail.
Reordered 'Torá una' to 'Una ley' (article-numeral-noun) for natural Spanish word order; participants, number, stem force, and conjunction sense left unchanged.
